permissions.body: Uma ukhetha ukuskena ikhodi QR, KaalKey isebenzisa imvume yekhamera yaleso senzo. Ukufakazela ubuqiniso bedivayisi ongakukhetha kanye nempendulo ye-haptic kusebenzisa izici zedivayisi ezifanele. Ungaphatha izimvume kuzilungiselelo zedivayisi yakho.
permissions.heading: 2. Izimvume nezici zedivayisi

backups.body: Uma udala ikhophi yasenqolobaneni, KaalKey ibhala isipele usebenzisa iphasiwedi oyikhethayo. Gcina kokubili ifayela nephasiwedi kuyimfihlo futhi ukugcine ngokuphephile. Noma ubani othola ifayela nephasiwedi yalo angakwazi ukubuyisela ama-akhawunti akho okufakazela ubuqiniso. KaalKey ayikwazi ukuthola igama eliyisipele elikhohliwe.
backups.heading: 3. Izipele

security.body: Gcina idivayisi yakho ibuyekeziwe, ivikele ngokukhiya isikrini, futhi ungabelani OTP izimfihlo noma amaphasiwedi ayisipele. Ukususa uhlelo lokusebenza, ukusula idatha yalo, noma ukulahlekelwa idivayisi kungenza ama-akhawunti agcinwe endaweni angatholakali. Gcina ikhophi yasenqolobaneni evikelekile uma udinga ukutakula.
security.heading: 5. Ukuphepha nokugcinwa

information.heading: 1. Ulwazi nezimfihlo
information.body: KaalKey wuhlelo lokusebenza lokufakazela ubuqiniso. Amalebula e-akhawunti kanye namanani ayimfihlo adingekayo ukuze kwenziwe amakhodi esikhathi esisodwa abucayi. Uhlelo lokusebenza luklanyelwe ukugcina amarekhodi e-akhawunti endaweni yokugcina evikelekile yedivayisi. Noma ubani okwazi ukufinyelela idivayisi evuliwe noma ikhophi yasenqolobaneni ethunyelwe angakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olubucayi.

sharing.heading: 4. Ukwabelana kanye nabesithathu
sharing.body: Ukugeleza kwekhophi yasenqolobaneni kungase kusebenzise ishidi lokwabelana ledivayisi yakho noma isikhethi samafayela ukuze ulondoloze, udlulise, noma ukhethe amafayela. Izinqubo zobumfihlo zanoma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza lwenkampani yangaphandle noma isevisi oyikhethayo ibuswa yilowo mhlinzeki. Lesi saziso asenzi isimangalo esigcwele sokuthi idivayisi yakho, isistimu yokusebenza, noma izinsiza zokwabelana ezikhethiwe azikwazi ukucubungula idatha.

changes.heading: 6. Izinguquko kanye nokuxhumana
changes.body: Lesi saziso esishumekiwe singabuyekezwa ekukhishweni kohlelo lokusebenza okuzayo. Ngemibuzo yobumfihlo, xhumana nomshicileli wohlelo lokusebenza ngesiteshi esisemthethweni sokwesekwa esinikezwe nohlelo lokusebenza.

use.body: Ungasebenzisa i-KaalKey ukwenza amakhodi okuqinisekisa ama-akhawunti ogunyazwe ukuwafinyelela. Unesibopho sokuthobela imithetho esebenzayo kanye nemithetho yamasevisi owasebenzisayo amakhodi okuqinisekisa.
use.heading: 1. Ukusebenzisa kwakho

protectAccounts.body: Unesibopho sokuvikela idivayisi yakho, izimfihlo zokufakazela ubuqiniso, izindlela zokuthola kabusha, izipele ezikhishiwe, namaphasiwedi ayisipele. Ungabelani ngamakhodi noma izimfihlo nabantu ongabathembi.
protectAccounts.heading: 2. Vikela ama-akhawunti akho

availability.body: Izici zingashintsha phakathi kokukhishwa. Kufanele ugcine uhlelo lokusebenza lubuyekeziwe futhi ngezikhathi ezithile uqinisekise ukuthi isipele sakho kanye nezinhlelo zokuthola kabusha ziyasebenza.
availability.heading: 5. Izinguquko nokutholakala

recovery.body: KaalKey ayikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke i-akhawunti ingatholwa, ukuthi yonke QR ikhodi noma ukulungiselelwa kuzohambisana, noma ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza luzosebenza ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka noma iphutha. Gcina ezinye izindlela zokuthola kabusha ezinikezwa isevisi efanele.
recovery.heading: 3. Asikho isiqinisekiso sokuthola kabusha

advice.heading: 4. Akukho seluleko sochwepheshe
advice.body: Uhlelo lokusebenza luwumsebenzi futhi alunikezi iseluleko sezomthetho, sezezimali, noma sezokuphepha. Uma i-akhawunti ifakwa engcupheni, landela isiqondiso esisemthethweni sokuthola nokuvikeleka kwesevisi ethintekile.

liability.heading: 6. Isibopho somthetho kanye nomthetho osebenzayo
liability.body: Ngokwezinga elivunyelwe umthetho osebenzayo, uhlelo lokusebenza lunikezwa ngaphandle kwesiqinisekiso sokusebenza okungaphazamiseki noma okungenaphutha. Akukho lutho kule migomo okungafaki amalungelo noma amakhambi angeke akhishwe ngokusemthethweni. Noma yimiphi eminye imikhawulo noma imigomo yomthetho olawulayo kufanele ibuyekezwe ngummeli oqeqeshiwe endaweni yomshicileli ngaphambi kokukhululwa.

legal.reviewBothDocuments: Sicela ubuyekeze yomibili imibhalo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa KaalKey. Zifakiwe kuhlelo lokusebenza futhi zitholakala ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.

legal.iReadAgree: Ngifundile futhi ngiyavumelana Nenqubomgomo Yobumfihlo kanye Nemigomo Yokusebenzisa.
